description: Signal connections in a scene file. Each connection answers with its flags as the number and as flagNames; persist is on every connection, since a scene saves no other kind. A connect of a pair already connected says alreadyConnected, with flagsBefore when it changed the flags. Needs the editor connected. Operations: connect (needs sourceNodePath, signalName, targetNodePath, methodName): connect a signal to a method; disconnect (needs sourceNodePath, signalName, targetNodePath, methodName): remove a connection; list: every connection in the scene.

flags.description: connect: Object.ConnectFlags, such as 1 for deferred.

methodName.description: The method on that node, called when it emits.

nodePath.description: list: only connections involving this node.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

signalName.description: The signal it emits, such as "pressed".

targetNodePath.description: The node whose method is called.

name: scene_signal
title: Scene signals
